name: stashme
description: Read your StashMe lists in ChatGPT: places, events, films, recipes, books and notes saved from social media posts.

interface.longDescription:
StashMe turns posts you save from Instagram and other feeds into lists: restaurants and places, events, films and series, recipes, books, products and notes. Connect your StashMe account to ask ChatGPT about what you saved, for example where to have dinner on Saturday, which exhibitions are still on this month, or what to cook from your saved recipes.

The plugin is read only. ChatGPT can list your items with filters by type, state and shelf, open one item with its facts (address, hours, dates, ingredients), look at the original saved post and get map coordinates of saved places. It cannot add, change or delete anything. Prices and purchase links for products are not shared.

You need a StashMe account with an activated invite code. Most saved content is in Russian.
capabilities: List saved places, events, films, recipes, books and notes
Open one saved item with its facts
Get map coordinates of saved places
defaultPrompt: Where should I have dinner from the restaurants I saved?
Which events I saved are coming up this month?
Plan a weekly menu from my saved recipes.

positive.prompt: Which restaurants have I saved in StashMe?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_items with types restaurant and returns the saved restaurants of the test account with their short descriptions.

positive.description: Open one saved place with its facts
positive.prompt: Show the address and opening hours of the first restaurant from my StashMe list.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the restaurant with list_items, then calls get_item and answers with the address, city and hours stored for that item.

positive.prompt: What events did I save in StashMe?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_items with types event and lists the saved events with their venue and dates.

positive.prompt: Suggest a dinner from the recipes I saved in StashMe and list the ingredients.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists saved recipes, opens one with get_item and returns its ingredients and steps without inventing items that are not stored.

positive.prompt: Give me the coordinates of the places I saved in StashMe so I can put them on a map.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_place_pins and returns place names with latitude and longitude from the test account.

negative.prompt: Delete all my saved posts in StashMe.

negative.description: Purchases and prices are not shared
negative.prompt: Buy the jacket I saved in StashMe and tell me its price.

negative.description: Another person's saves are not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me what my friend Anna saved in StashMe.

review.commerce_description: StashMe does not sell anything through ChatGPT. The connector is read only and does not share prices or purchase links.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only access to StashMe lists, items, original posts and place coordinates.

ru-RU.subtitle: Сохранёнки в виде списков
ru-RU.description:
СтэшМи превращает посты, которые ты сохраняешь в Instagram и других лентах, в списки: рестораны и места, события, фильмы и сериалы, рецепты, книги, покупки и заметки. Подключи аккаунт и спрашивай ChatGPT о сохранённом: куда сходить поужинать в субботу, какие выставки ещё идут в этом месяце, что приготовить из сохранённых рецептов.

Доступ только на чтение. ChatGPT видит списки с фильтрами по типу, состоянию и полке, открывает одну сущность с фактами (адрес, часы, даты, ингредиенты), исходный пост и координаты мест. Добавить, изменить или удалить что-то он не может. Цены и ссылки на покупку вещей не передаются.

Нужен аккаунт СтэшМи с активированным кодом приглашения.
